comments.overrides.next: Pin Next to 16.3.8 across the whole tree (apps + the @opennextjs/cloudflare peer). Next 16.4.0 moves preview props into a standalone .next/server/preview-props.json that the adapter's manifest-inlining glob doesn't bundle, so every route throws 'Unexpected loadManifest(/.next/server/preview-props.json)' (1101) at runtime. See opennextjs/opennextjs-cloudflare#1355. Remove once a released adapter includes PR #1356.
